name: rust-crate-identity
body: The Rust frontend's crate-identity and module-prefix mechanism: `rust.apg-rustfrontend.package_prefix_map` (which decides, per crate root, whether the cargo package name overrides the module prefix) and `rust.apg-rustfrontend.crate_prefix` (which renders a crate's prefix from the package override, else the target display name, else the root module name). It must give each local crate of a multi-target package a distinct, stable prefix. `rust.apg.ingest.insert_node` is the ingestor-side backstop that panics on any residual duplicate project node FQN.
